semantic_events.rationale: POST broadens the age upper bound from 25 to 30. 18-25 is a proper subset of 18-30, so POST is an expansion of the same demographic attribute. The lower bound (18) and the framing of the age band are retained.

The same broad territory (global orientation) persists but is reconceived from a demographic fact to a mindset. Subsumption test fails — being from all over the world is not a specific way of being globally-minded (you can be globally-minded without being from everywhere).
